events.description:
We invite you to come along to our Careers Workshop with
Ian Newman. Ian graduated from Lancaster University with an Economics
and Politics degree. He’s been a Career Mentor on the University’s Career
Mentoring Programme since it was launched in 2008 and, since then,  has
mentored over 200 students. In November 2023, he was awarded an Honorary Fellowship
for the extensive support he provides to the University and its students on
careers and employability. He supports around 25 students each year as part of
the Career Mentoring Programme. Ian has worked for The Stock Exchange, Royal Mail, The
Home Office, UK Border Agency and the Department for Work and Pensions. His
role at DWP was as the Deputy Head of Internal Communications, managing a team
of 70 people at a variety of locations in the UK.  He is currently the
Director for Regions for the Jaguar Enthusiasts’ Club, the largest Jaguar Club
worldwide. This careers workshop will cover the following topics: - How

events.title: Canoe Taster Session 6/10/26 07:30
events.description: Interested in exploring the lovely rivers of the surrounding countryside? Or an adrenaline junkie yearning for some rapids? Or maybe you want to try a weird new sport where you pass and shoot a water polo ball while in a kayak. Whether you've never sat in a kayak or have done loads of kayaking before, we would love you to come down and give our sport a try. Take part in this FREE taster session where you can try out canoeing in a safe space and see if it might be something you want to continue this year. You must have the free temporary expression of interest membership in order to be able to sign up. Remember to bring some clothes you don't mind getting soggy. We ask you to have a shirt and shorts on (feel free to wear a swimming costume underneath, etc). A towel and a change of clothes are also advisable! Be at the sports centre lobby just by reception before 07:30 on Tuesday 6th of October, and we will take you through to the pool and introduce everything to you. We will go through some formalities, like a 50m swim (2 lengths), and how to safely get out of the boat if you tip over. Once these are out of the way, we'll get to playing some games, an insight into what we get up to every week! If you have any questions, please drop @lancsunicanoeclub a message on Instagram or send us an email at lancasteruniversitycanoeclub@googlemail.com

events.title: Surgical Skills 101 - Suturing & Knot Tying
events.description: Surgical Skills 101: The Basics of Suturing and OR Conduct Ever wondered what's expected of you in theatre, or how to actually close a wound? Join the Richard Owen Society for a two-hour, hands-on introduction to operating theatre etiquette and fundamental suturing. We'll start with the basics of the OR: sterile zones, scrubbing, who's who in the theatre team, and how medical students are expected to conduct themselves. Then you'll learn and practise interrupted sutures, followed by continuous sutures. Each technique begins with a short demonstration, then supervised practice with facilitators and a consultant on hand to give feedback and correct common errors. We'll finish by comparing the two techniques and discussing suture choice and wound types. By the end of the session, you'll be able to: Show correct OR etiquette and identify team roles Choose suitable suture and needle types for basic closures Perform interrupted and continuous sutures on synthetic models Explain wound tension principles and the reasoning behind suture selection

events.description: Interested in exploring the lovely rivers of the surrounding countryside? Or an adrenaline junkie yearning for some rapids? Or maybe you want to try a weird new sport where you pass and shoot a water polo ball while in a kayak. Whether you've never sat in a kayak or have done loads of kayaking before, we would love you to come down and give our sport a try. Once these are out of the way, we'll get to playing some games, an insight into what we get up to every week! events.title: Lancaster Sail Week 2027
events.description: LUSC x ARMADA WEEK GREECE ⛵☀️ Get ready for a week of sun, sailing, island hopping and unforgettable nights as Lancaster University Sailing Club heads to Greece for Armada Week ! We’ll be setting sail from Athens and spending the week exploring the Greek islands as part of a huge flotilla of yachts. Expect crystal-clear water, secluded swimming spots, beautiful harbours and plenty of time to relax in the sun during the day, followed by organised events, bars and parties in a different destination each night. Across the week, we’ll sail between destinations including Agia Marina, Perdika, Ermioni, Dokos and Poros , stopping off at coves and anchorages along the way. There’ll be everything from beach activities and sunset drinks to raft parties, fancy dress and big nights out — all alongside other crews taking part in Armada Week. You don’t need to be an experienced sailor to come along. Each yacht has a skipper responsible for getting the boat safely between destinations, so this is as much a summer holiday and social as it is a sailing trip. Whether you’re coming for the sailing, Greek sunshine, swimming, nightlife, or just a ridiculous week away with LUSC, this is set to be one of the highlights of the year. Think Greek islands + yacht week ⛵🍻 More details on dates, travel, prices and how to secure your place will be announced by the club. Armada Week itinerary: https://www.armada-week.com/en-gb/aboutweekgreece
